items.description: The boundary layer (app/routes) does not import the database session or engine
The boundary layer (app/routes) contains no SQLAlchemy ORM imports
The service layer (app/services) contains no SQLAlchemy ORM imports
All persistence writes for the file-stock operation are performed exclusively inside the repository layer
The database connection string is supplied via an environment variable and is not hardcoded in source
Filing a stock level for a new (SKU, location) pair persists a record holding the exact SKU, location, and quantity
The service layer rejects a file-stock request with a negative quantity before any repository call is made
Inserting a stock_records row with sku=NULL directly against the branch DB raises an IntegrityError
Inserting a stock_records row with location=NULL directly against the branch DB raises an IntegrityError
Inserting a stock_records row with quantity=NULL directly against the branch DB raises an IntegrityError
Inserting a stock_records row with quantity less than zero directly against the branch DB raises a check constraint violation
After a single-step Alembic downgrade followed by a single-step upgrade, the stock_records table exists with all its columns and constraints present
Filing a stock record with a combined tracking code persists the inventory_code value exactly as supplied
Re-filing stock for an existing (SKU, location) pair updates the existing record in place and leaves exactly one record for that pair
Re-filing stock for an existing (SKU, location) pair returns a success response with no error
Inserting two stock_records rows with the same (sku, location) pair directly via the ORM raises a unique constraint violation
